captions.detailed: A compact travel camcorder in a dark matte finish. It features a rectangular main body with a top-mounted accessory shoe, a prominent multi-tiered cylindrical lens barrel extending from the front, and a flat rectangular flip-out screen panel mounted on the left side. The screen panel pivots outward on a vertical hinge, the lens focus ring rotates continuously around the barrel, and three small rectangular buttons on the left body wall act as depressible push controls.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a travel camcorder. It should feature a main rectangular body with rounded vertical edges, a multi-stage cylindrical lens barrel extending from the front, and a rectangular flip screen on the left side. Incorporate three small prismatic push buttons below the screen area. Define appropriate joints for the flip screen (revolute), the focus ring (continuous), and the buttons (prismatic).
captions.factory: The main body is constructed using a rounded Box primitive combined with a smaller top Box for the accessory shoe. The lens consists of multiple concentric Cylinder primitives of varying diameters stacked along the longitudinal axis. The flip screen is modeled as a flat Box connected via a revolute joint on a vertical pivot. Three small Box primitives are positioned on the lower left side of the body, each assigned a prismatic joint to simulate button depression.
